mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.data, m.inserted_at, m.updated_at, s1.unique_key AS sub1_unique_key, s1.main_id AS sub1_main_id, s1.sub_data AS sub1_data, s2.unique_key AS sub2_unique_key, s2.main_id AS sub2_main_id, s2.sub_data AS sub2_data FROM main_table m LEFT JOIN sub_table1 s1 ON m.id = s1.main_id LEFT JOIN sub_table2 s2 ON m.id = s2.main_id

SELECT m.id, m.data, m.inserted_at, m.updated_at, s1.unique_key AS sub1_unique_key, s1.main_id AS sub1_main_id, s1.sub_data AS sub1_data, s2.unique_key AS sub2_unique_key, s2.main_id AS sub2_main_id, s2.sub_data AS sub2_data FROM main_table m LEFT JOIN sub_table1 s1 ON m.id = s1.main_id LEFT JOIN sub_table2 s2 ON m.id = s2.main_id WHERE m.id = #{id}
